name: @pruvz/evidence-packet
description: Public JSON Schema, synthetic examples, local structural validator and independent offline verifier for the Pruvz Public Evidence Packet export contract.

scripts.test: node --test test/validator.test.mjs test/compose.test.mjs test/canonical.test.mjs test/trust-registry.test.mjs test/evidence-log.test.mjs test/anchoring.test.mjs test/verify.test.mjs test/conformance.test.mjs
scripts.conformance: node conformance/node/run.mjs conformance/results/results-node.json && node bin/conformance-compare.mjs conformance/results/results-node.json
scripts.conformance:all: node conformance/node/run.mjs conformance/results/results-node.json && dotnet run --project conformance/dotnet -c Release -- . conformance/results/results-dotnet.json && python conformance/python/run.py conformance/results/results-python.json && node bin/conformance-compare.mjs conformance/results/results-node.json conformance/results/results-dotnet.json conformance/results/results-python.json
